title: PLDM Firmware Update Conditions
description: Schema for pre/post setup targets used by platform firmware update conditions.

Component.description: Component name used to map update conditions.

PreUpdateTarget.description: Systemd unit name to run before update, for example ABC_PreUpdate.service. A template unit name such as ABC_PreUpdate@.service receives all supported named arguments as its instance name. Omit this property when the component has no pre-condition.

PostUpdateTarget.description: Systemd unit name to run after a successful update, for example ABC_PostUpdate.service. A template unit name such as ABC_PostUpdate@.service receives all supported named arguments as its instance name. Omit this property when the component has no post-condition.
